description_en: Processes malicious sample alerts in batches
description_zh: 批量处理恶意样本告警
name: HandleSimilarMaliciousFiles

parameters.help_en:
The scenario for batch processing. Valid values:
same_file_md5: The same file MD5.
default: The same alerting type. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
批量处理的场景：
same_file_md5：相同文件md5；
default（默认值）：相同告警类型
parameters.name: scenario

parameters.help_en:
The handling action. Valid values:
addWhitelist: Adds the alert to the whitelist.
offWhitelist: Removes the alert from the whitelist.
offline_handled: Marks the alert as handled offline.
mark_mis_info: Submits the alert as a false positive.
ignore: Ignores the alert
parameters.help_zh:
处置动作：
addWhitelist：加白名单；
offWhitelist：取消加白；
offline_handled：线下已处理；
mark_mis_info：提交误报；
ignore：忽略
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target alert
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.help_en:
The file source. Valid values:
agentless: Host detection.
ecs_snapshot: User snapshot detection.
ecs_image: Custom image detection
parameters.help_zh:
文件来源。取值：
agentless：主机检测；
ecs_snapshot：用户快照检测；
ecs_image：用户自定义镜像检测
parameters.name: scan_range

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值包括：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Data.description_en: The number of alerts processed in the batch

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
